name: Brains!
author: seanjohn9848
description: Brains is a basic memory game. Touch a crate to reveal what's inside. Try to match the crates to score points and make them disappear. Be careful though, don't let the zombie ghost catch you as he follows you around to try and eat your brain! Pick up power-ups to boost your speed, shock the ghost or see through the boxes. Match all of the boxes to move on to the next level!
